scientific_question: If and only if independently validated v142.1 retains complete capacity and its pre-result adjudicator authorizes a downstream shell, can a current-roster shared linear dual-ridge map predict the canonical pair-depth coefficient direction from exact deployment-visible K1 state and reported geometry under complete-trajectory LOTO?
scientific_boundary: This preregistration freezes a teacher, split and cheapest learned baseline before the v142.1 complete result. It does not authorize teacher generation, fitting, prediction, scoring, neural training, exact-call reduction, speed, transfer, a breakthrough or paper success.

ineligible_actions.v142_1_failure: Close the representation and do not generate a teacher.
ineligible_actions.deterministic_control_blocks: Do not fit a predictor because the same-cost deterministic explanation suffices.
ineligible_actions.inconclusive_or_unsealed: Generate no teacher, features, model or score.

complete_teacher.teacher: exact same-observation zero-start CGLS detector-dual correction z4-z1
complete_teacher.canonicalization: unit coefficient RMS, then orient the physical projected direction to nonnegative teacher-projection inner product

inputs: directions generated from the same exact K1 state
deployment_feature_barrier.allowed_code_reuse: Only the stateless v141.3 camera/direction feature equations and token equations may be reused under a new source binding.

outer_split.inner_selection: leave one of the four outer-fit trajectories out

first_model.label: shared_linear_exact_k1_direction_ridge
first_model.design: shared target-camera, peer-camera, active-camera pooled, direction-observable and direction-token features
first_model.normalization: outer-fit only; refit inside every nested trajectory split
model_order: only after an independently validated ridge failure may a separate minimal nonlinear protocol be considered

decision_rule.ridge_passes_complete_gate: The current-roster linear ridge is the minimal sufficient learned baseline; do not train a nonlinear model. This remains opened-development evidence until an unopened public external gate passes.
decision_rule.ridge_fails_complete_gate: No learned advantage is established. A separate minimal permutation-equivariant nonlinear contract may be considered only because validated capacity remains, but it cannot reuse v141 artifacts or enlarge after a negative result.
decision_rule.execution_or_independent_validation_fail: Inconclusive; do not switch targets, shells, folds or metrics.
